rows: بدن الجهاز مصنع من الصلب طبقا" للشروط والمواصفات القياسية المصرية .

السطح الخارجى للجهاز معالج ومدهون الكتروستاتيك باللون الأحمر ويقاوم التآكل 
 نتيجة التعرض للظروف الجوية وتغطى القمة باللون الأصفر طبقا" للشروط والمواصفات 
 العالمية
الوحدة سهلة الصيانة وإعادة التعبئة بعد الاستخدام .
قلاووظ عنق الجهاز من النوع المسلوب القياسى برؤوس المحابس
الجهاز مزود بمحبس التشغيل به صمام أمان متصل بخرطوم فى نهايته بشبورى
الجهاز مركب على قاعدة لحمايته من أسفل عند وضعه على الأرض
ذويد للحمل بالنسبة للسعة 6 كجم
الجهاز محمل على عجل لسهولة الحركة والمناورة للسعة 10 ، 20 ، 30 كجم
تشغيل الجهاز يتم بواسطة شخص واحد
ضغط التشغيل = 140 بار ، وضغط الاختبار = 225 بار .
دورة التصريف المنقطع يفتح 4 ثانية ويقفل 4 ثانية للسعة 6 كجم

أعد 
المسودة الأولية واختبرها المهندس/أشرف 
جابر عرفه محمود: اخصائى دفاع 
مدنى أول بمحطة كهرباء طلخا وراجعها المهندس/محمود يوسف تهامى 
والمهندس/مدحت محمد طـه خاطر: أخصائى سلامة وصحة 
مهنية أول بقطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة شرق الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء 
ووافق عليها المهندس/فاروق عوض على مصطفى: المدير العام واعتمدها السيد 
المهندس/ فتحى محمود رجب: رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء طلخا

التفتيش

التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة شرق الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء

إصدار أمر شغل معتمد 
 من الجهة المختصة 
 ويجب 
 أن يحمل القائمون بأعمال الصيانة كارت 
 فئة السلامة والصحة المهنية
تسوير المكان ووضع علامات التحذير

اتباع إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية للأفراد 
 والمعدات وارتداء مهمات الوقاية الشخصية (خوذة 
 أمان ، حذاء أمان ، أفرول ، 00 الخ)
مهمات السلامة والصحة المهنية مثل خوذة أمان ، حذاء أمان ، أفرول 000 الخ
ميزان متنقل ، مفتاح بلدى
وصلة مانوميتر لقياس الضغط حتى 200 بار من الطفاية إلى المانوميتر .
تأكد من ترقيم الطفاية فى المكان المخصص لذلك0

تأكد 
 من وجود الطفاية فى مكانها طبقا لكشف توزيع الطفايات بالمحطة 
 ومرفوعة عن الأرض0

تأكد 
 من أن الطفاية فى مكان واضح وظاهـر بعيـدة عن العوامل الجويـة ( 
 شمس ، رطوبة .... )

تأكد 
 من 
 عدم وجود عوائق تحول دون الوصول إلى الطفاية فى أسرع وقت ممكن0

تأكد 
 من وجود خرطوم الطرد والقاذف ومحبس البلف بحالة جيدة0

تأكد 
 من وجود الترصيص الخاص ببلف الطفاية سليم0

تأكد 
 من عمل نظافة كاملة للطفاية0

تأكد 
 من صلاحية كل من الشاسية الحديدى والعجل وذلك بالنسبة للأجهزة المحمولة على 
 عجل0

يوقع
 القائم بالمرور على سجل المرور اليومى بما يفيد صلاحية الطفايات 
 الموجودة فى منطقته المسئول عنها أو وجود طفاية تحتاج للصيانة محددا" أرقامها 
 بالسجل0

Document No.: FS-033-r0a
Equipment: Manual CO2 and powder fire extinguishers, wheeled
Issued to: Middle Delta Electricity Production Company
Status: Approved
Approval date: 07 March 2006
Procedure: Daily periodic patrol (I1-D1)

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps followed when carrying out the daily patrol on manual wheeled CO2 fire extinguishers, which are used in fire fighting as the gas replaces the oxygen in the air in the combustion atmosphere

rows: The body of the extinguisher is made of steel in accordance with the Egyptian standard conditions and specifications.

The outer surface of the extinguisher is treated and electrostatically painted red and resists corrosion from exposure to weather conditions, and the top is covered in yellow in accordance with international conditions and specifications
The unit is easy to maintain and refill after use.
The neck thread of the extinguisher is of the standard tapered type for valve heads
The extinguisher is fitted with an operating valve with a safety valve connected to a hose ending in a nozzle
The extinguisher is mounted on a base to protect it from below when placed on the ground
Fitted with a carrying handle for the 6 kg capacity
The extinguisher is wheeled for easy movement and manoeuvring for capacities of 10, 20, 30 kg
The extinguisher is operated by one person
Operating pressure = 140 bar, and test pressure = 225 bar.
Intermittent discharge cycle: opens 4 seconds and closes 4 seconds for the 6 kg capacity

The first draft was prepared and tested by Eng. Ashraf Gaber Arafa Mahmoud: Senior Civil Defence Specialist at Talkha Power Station, reviewed by Eng. Mahmoud Youssef Tahamy and Eng. Medhat Mohamed Taha Khater: Senior Occupational Safety and Health Specialists in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at East Delta Electricity Production Company, approved by Eng. Farouk Awad Ali Mostafa: General Manager, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab: Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector

Approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil: General Director of Inspection and Quality Control at East Delta Electricity Production Company and the company coordinator for the Maintenance Procedure Information System, and certified by Mr. Accountant Mahmoud Soliman: General Director of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at East Delta Electricity Production Company
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Fence off the area and place warning signs
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, 00 etc.)
Occupational safety and health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls 000 etc.
Portable scale, open-end wrench
Manometer connection to measure pressure up to 200 bar, from the extinguisher to the manometer.
Check that the extinguisher is numbered in the designated place0
Check that the extinguisher is in its place according to the station extinguisher distribution list and raised off the ground0
Check that the extinguisher is in a clear, visible place, away from weather factors (sun, humidity ....)
Check that there are no obstructions preventing reaching the extinguisher as quickly as possible0
Check that the discharge hose, the nozzle and the valve are in good condition0
Check that the sealing of the extinguisher valve is intact0
Check that the extinguisher is fully cleaned0
Check the serviceability of the steel chassis and the wheels for wheeled extinguishers0

The patrolling person signs the daily patrol log confirming the serviceability of the extinguishers in his area of responsibility or the presence of an extinguisher needing maintenance, specifying their numbers in the log0

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedure Information System
Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Fire Fighting Systems | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: FS-033-r0a | Equipment: Manual CO2 and powder fire extinguishers, wheeled
Issued to: Middle Delta Electricity Production Company
Status: Approved
Approval date: 07 March 2006 | Procedure: Daily periodic patrol (I1-D1)
Next review date: March 2006
Introduction
This document sets out the steps followed when carrying out the daily patrol on manual wheeled CO2 fire extinguishers, which are used in fire fighting as the gas replaces the oxygen in the air in the combustion atmosphere
Technical specifications of the extinguisher:
The body of the extinguisher is made of steel in accordance with the Egyptian standard conditions and specifications. | 
The outer surface of the extinguisher is treated and electrostatically painted red and resists corrosion from exposure to weather conditions, and the top is covered in yellow in accordance with international conditions and specifications | 
The unit is easy to maintain and refill after use. | 
The neck thread of the extinguisher is of the standard tapered type for valve heads | 
The extinguisher is fitted with an operating valve with a safety valve connected to a hose ending in a nozzle | 
The extinguisher is mounted on a base to protect it from below when placed on the ground | 
Fitted with a carrying handle for the 6 kg capacity | 
The extinguisher is wheeled for easy movement and manoeuvring for capacities of 10, 20, 30 kg | 
The extinguisher is operated by one person | 
Operating pressure = 140 bar, and test pressure = 225 bar. | 
Intermittent discharge cycle: opens 4 seconds and closes 4 seconds for the 6 kg capacity | 
The first draft was prepared and tested by Eng. Ashraf Gaber Arafa Mahmoud: Senior Civil Defence Specialist at Talkha Power Station, reviewed by Eng. Mahmoud Youssef Tahamy and Eng. Medhat Mohamed Taha Khater: Senior Occupational Safety and Health Specialists in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at East Delta Electricity Production Company, approved by Eng. Farouk Awad Ali Mostafa: General Manager, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab: Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector | 
Approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil: General Director of Inspection and Quality Control at East Delta Electricity Production Company and the company coordinator for the Maintenance Procedure Information System, and certified by Mr. Accountant Mahmoud Soliman: General Director of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at East Delta Electricity Production Company | 
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card | 
Fence off the area and place warning signs | 
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, 00 etc.) | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Occupational safety and health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls 000 etc. | 
Portable scale, open-end wrench | 
Manometer connection to measure pressure up to 200 bar, from the extinguisher to the manometer. | 
Work to be Carried Out
Check that the extinguisher is numbered in the designated place0 | 1.
Check that the extinguisher is in its place according to the station extinguisher distribution list and raised off the ground0 | 2.
Check that the extinguisher is in a clear, visible place, away from weather factors (sun, humidity ....) | 3.
Check that there are no obstructions preventing reaching the extinguisher as quickly as possible0 | 4.
Check that the discharge hose, the nozzle and the valve are in good condition0 | 5.
Check that the sealing of the extinguisher valve is intact0 | 6.
Check that the extinguisher is fully cleaned0 | 7.
Check the serviceability of the steel chassis and the wheels for wheeled extinguishers0 | 8.
The patrolling person signs the daily patrol log confirming the serviceability of the extinguishers in his area of responsibility or the presence of an extinguisher needing maintenance, specifying their numbers in the log0 | 9.
